notes: Subagents are real: the main agent can hand whole subtasks — or an entire QA pass — to a focused sub-agent that runs in the same workspace, reads files itself, and reports back. Models split into three categories (main · subagent · media) so your coding model, your sub-agent model, and your vision model are chosen independently. And test mode goes deep: screenshots flow to the dedicated vision model, which returns a real UI review — typography, responsiveness, contrast, accessibility — not just "does it load".
